# HomaCRM for WordPress (افزونهٔ پیامک و CRM وردپرس هما)

> HomaCRM is a free WordPress and WooCommerce plugin that connects a site to the HomaCRM platform with one API token: order SMS, passwordless login with a mobile one-time code, abandoned-cart recovery by SMS, CRM sync (contacts, deals, leads, support tickets), warehouse, invoices and a payment gateway for WooCommerce. Requires WordPress 5.2+ and PHP 7.2+. GPLv2 or later. A free 15-day HomaCRM trial is available.
> افزونهٔ رسمی HomaCRM برای وردپرس و ووکامرس: پیامک خودکار سفارش، ورود و ثبت‌نام با موبایل، یادآوری سبد رهاشده و CRM، فقط با یک توکن API. ۱۵ روز مهمان ما باشید.

## Product
- [Landing page / صفحهٔ معرفی](https://plugin.homacrm.com/): features, installation steps, technical specifications, FAQ (Persian) and an English summary
- [Full content as Markdown](https://plugin.homacrm.com/llms-full.txt): everything on the landing page in plain text for AI assistants
- [Get the plugin](https://plugin.homacrm.com/install): enter your email and the download link (latest zip, version = the live HomaCRM version plus a release number, e.g. 3.13.16.1) is emailed to you; the source is also on GitHub

## Documentation
- [Source code and README on GitHub](https://github.com/Homa-OS/Plugins-HomaCRM): readme, changelog, hooks, REST endpoints, shortcodes
- [HomaCRM External API documentation](https://homacrm.com/api/v1/external/docs): authentication, messaging, CRM, warehouse, finance endpoints; how to get an API token
- [HomaCRM website](https://homacrm.com/): the platform behind the plugin
